content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to working with PLCs and I'm looking for recommendations on tutorials or guidance for exchanging variables between [company_name] devices over Profinet. My setup includes two [product_name] controllers with I/O expansion modules, a basic HMI panel, and an industrial PC-based HMI all connected over Profinet. I'm using [product_name] engineering software for the HMIs and [product_name] software for PLC logic programming. Communication across the network is established—I can control multiple outputs and read digital feedback using basic commands. However, I'm having trouble transferring variables, such as feeding an integer from an HMI input field into a delay block on the PLC. So far, I've created a simple on-delay function in the [product_name] software, assigned a tag address in the HMI project, but it's not having any effect in runtime. Any advice on how to properly set this up would be appreciated. Thank you very much!

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum! Is the connection labeled "Conn4_rck_477E" linked to a [product_name] device? If not, have you configured a connection to a [product_name] in your engineering project?

Hi, thanks for the warm and quick welcome! Everything is communicating properly—I can operate all [product_name] modules from both HMIs, controlling real outputs and reading digital inputs for system feedback. My current challenge is enabling variable passing between the HMIs and [product_name] controllers. For example, I want to enter an integer in an HMI input field to set an on-delay block parameter. I'm finding it difficult to configure these parameters, so any guidance is much appreciated.
I've attached an example showing how to set a timer value from the HMI panel to the [product_name] controller.
That's extremely helpful! Thank you so much for your assistance—this gives me a solid starting point and plenty to experiment with. All the best!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is navigating the challenge of transferring variables, especially integer data, between HMI panels and [product_name] controllers in a Profinet-based system. They are competent with basic control and feedback but are seeking knowledge on higher-level variable mapping, such as using HMI input to configure PLC timer functions. This discussion reflects a transition from elementary monitoring to more complex integration, highlighting a gap in understanding parameter exchange in interconnected [company_name] products.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking clear and practical advice on configuring workflows that allow HMI user inputs to adjust PLC logic parameters directly and efficiently within [company_name] systems.
